department: Department of Mathematical Sciences (Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School)

deadline.value: Stipend calls run twice a year, with deadlines 1 November and 1 April; the 1 November 2026 call is the first for Fall 2027 entry (the next is 1 April 2027).
deadline.quote: We have calls for applications to all our available stipends twice a year, with deadline November 1st and April 1st, respectively.

supervisor.value: You must have an agreement with a principal supervisor at the Faculty of Science before you apply for admission.
supervisor.quote: You must have a principal supervisor employed at one of the departments at the Faculty of Science, and you must have an agreement with your supervisor before you apply for admission.

funding.value: You need a stipend covering salary and university fees to be admitted; the department offers a number of PhD stipends every year.
funding.quote: a stipend to cover your living expenses (your salary) and the fees (taxameter) to the university | The department offers a number of PhD stipends every year.

entry_route.value: The usual entry level for the 3-year PhD is a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The usual entry level for our (3 years) PhD program is a Master's Degree.
